info.title: Resume Screener API
info.description: Authenticate with a Google session (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`) or an API key (`X-API-Key`). API keys are limited per minute; above the limit the API returns 429.

idToken.description: ID token returned by Google Identity Services on the frontend.

message.example: Some fields are invalid. Check the highlighted fields.

configVersion.description: Version of the scoring config; increases when requirements change.

skillWeights.description: Weights for single skills, overriding the weight of their kind. Each skill must be one of the job's skills. Replaces the whole list.

manualReviewThreshold.description: Below this model confidence on a mandatory requirement, the candidate is marked "Needs manual review".

requiredSkills.description: Mandatory skills. A candidate without one is marked "Does not meet requirements".

minMatchScore.description: Candidates scoring below this are shown at the bottom of the list.

scoring.description: How requirements are weighted and when to ask for manual review. Omitted fields keep their current (or default) values.

requiredSkills.description: Mandatory skills. A candidate without one is marked "Does not meet requirements".

minMatchScore.description: Candidates scoring below this are shown at the bottom of the list.

scoring.description: How requirements are weighted and when to ask for manual review. Omitted fields keep their current (or default) values.

configVersion.description: Version of the scoring config; increases when requirements change.

rescoreSuggested.description: True when the requirements changed and the job already has resumes. Offer to re-score them with POST /jobs/{jobId}/rescore.

duplicateOfResumeId.description: Set for duplicates: the resume already uploaded.

reason.description: Why the file was rejected or skipped.

results.description: One entry per file, in upload order.

lastError.description: Readable reason for the last failure.

candidateId.description: The candidate created from this resume, once processed.

belowThreshold.description: Below the job minimum score; shown separately at the bottom.

points.description: Points this requirement added to the score.

maxPoints.description: Points it could add at most.

requirements.description: Each requirement's verdict and contribution to the score.

url.description: Opens the original file; works until expiresAt.

to.description: Inclusive only for the last bucket.

aboveThreshold.description: At or above the job minimum score.

requirements.description: How many candidates meet each of the job's current requirements.

topCandidates.description: Best candidates at or above the minimum score.

apiRateLimitPerMinute.description: Requests per minute per API key that apply now.

customRateLimitPerMinute.description: Requests per minute per API key instead of the plan's limit. null removes a custom limit; omit to keep the current one.
